title: Pictorial Marking for Handling and Labelling of Goods, Part 2: General Goods
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 1260 (PART 2)) covers Pictorial Marking for Handling and Labelling of Goods, Part 2: General Goods. This Indian Standard ( Third Revision ) which is identical with ISO 780 : 1997 Packaging — Pictorial marking for handling of goods', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Packages Sectional Committee and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The original standard was published in 1958. The first revision was brought out in 1973 after amalgamating and into one standard and the various aspects covered in different parts. The second revision of Part 2 was published in 1979, covering pictorial markings on packages containing general goods. Part 1 of this standard ( first revision ), published in 1973, covers pictorial markings for dangerous goods. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations.
